tool.name: propose_project_create
tool.description:
Propose project.create for review; never apply it to the live books. Create a new active project, with an optional code, manager and budget limit; this does not create or move any ledger entries.
Example input: {"name":"Fit-out","code":"FIT","budgetLimitCents":12300}
INVALID_INPUT: The project has no name or the fields are not valid. Supply a name and check the fields.
PAYMENT_REQUIRED: The developer API credit balance is exhausted. Check the workspace billing settings.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The developer API spending limit was reached. Ask an administrator to check the workspace quota.

budgetLimitCents.description: Budget in whole cents; the legacy API also accepts a numeric string

tool.name: propose_project_delete
tool.description:
Propose project.delete for review; never apply it to the live books. Delete one project and answer with the row that was removed, so it can be restored; do not use it to remove the documents that point at the project — they keep their own rows.
Example input: {"id":"proj_web"}
NOT_FOUND: The project is not in the selected workspace, or is already gone. Reload the projects and choose one in this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.
INVALID_INPUT: The id is missing or carries a slash. Send the project id as it appears in the projects list.

tool.name: propose_project_restore
tool.description:
Propose project.restore for review; never apply it to the live books. Put back a project that project.delete removed, from the row the server kept; do not use it to overwrite a project that exists — that is a project.update.
Example input: {"id":"proj_web"}
CONFLICT: A project with this id already exists. Keep the project that is there, or delete it first to restore the older row.
NOT_FOUND: Nothing is on record for this id in this workspace. Check the id, and that the project was deleted from this workspace.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner, accountant or bookkeeper. Ask a workspace owner to grant an appropriate role.
INVALID_INPUT: The row has no id, or carries an id with a slash. Send the project row that project.delete answered with.

tool.name: propose_record_save
tool.description:
Propose record.save for review; never apply it to the live books. Create or save a whole ordinary record — a purchase order, a recurring rule, a tax rate, a project, an asset, an estimate, an inventory item or a loan note — and never a ledger collection, whose own command owns the postings.
Example input: {"collection":"purchaseOrders","id":"po-1","data":{"status":"approved"},"unset":["binLocations.store-1"]}
INVALID_INPUT: The collection is not an ordinary record, the record is empty or too large, or a field name is empty. Use the command that owns that collection, or send the fields the screen shows.
NOT_FOUND: The record is not in the selected workspace, or a save names an id that does not exist without asking to create it. Reload the list and open a record in this workspace.
CONFLICT: A create names an id that is already taken, or the save changes a field only a ledger command may change (asset depreciation or disposal, stock or cost of a stocked item, an accepted estimate, a received purchase order). Open that record and save it, or let the server choose the id.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is a viewer. Ask an owner, accountant or bookkeeper to save the record.

tool.name: propose_time_rates
tool.description:
Propose time.rates for review; never apply it to the live books. Set hourly rates by project, customer, or person for future time-value calculations; do not use this to edit the rate stored on an individual entry.
Example input: {"rates":{"projects":{"project_1":9500},"customers":{"customer_1":8000},"people":{"user_1":7000}}}
INVALID_INPUT: A rate is missing, negative, fractional, or the maps are too large. Use nonnegative whole cents per hour in maps of up to 2,000 entries.
ROLE_REQUIRED: The caller is not an owner or accountant. Ask a workspace owner or accountant to maintain hourly rates.
NOT_FOUND: The selected workspace no longer exists. Choose an existing workspace.

turns.question: Summarise how the business did this year in plain words.
turns.why: must state this year's revenue (518500) or profit (165800)
turns.answer:
Overall, the business has had a solid, profitable year so far. From **January 1, 2026 through November 22, 2026**, you kept nearly a third of every dollar earned as net profit, and you have a healthy cash buffer with very little owed to suppliers.

### 1. Money earned vs. money spent (Year to date)
* **Total revenue:** **$518,500.00**
  * Sales brought in the vast majority at **$467,000.00**, with consulting income adding **$51,500.00**.
* **Total expenses:** **$352,700.00**
  * Your biggest running costs were **Wages ($220,000.00)** and **Rent ($99,000.00)**, followed by **Office costs ($20,500.00)** and **Utilities ($13,200.00)**.
* **Net profit:** **$165,800.00** (a profit margin of **31.98%** — exact tool output `31.976856316297%`).

### 2. Recent pace
* **Last month (October 2026):** You brought in **$52,000.00** and spent **$32,000.00**, leaving **$20,000.00** in profit.
* **This month so far (November 2026, partial month through Nov 22):** You have brought in **$45,000.00** and spent **$33,000.00**, leaving **$12,000.00** in profit with just over a week left in the month.

### 3. Where things stand today (as of November 22, 2026)
* **Cash and bank:** **$96,845.00** total on hand (**$84,500.00** in the bank and **$12,345.00** in cash).
* **Owed to you (Accounts receivable):** **$8,727.00** from customers.
* **Owed by you (Accounts payable):** **$950.00** to suppliers/vendors.

---

**Sources & notes:**
* **Profit and Loss report** (`profit-and-loss`), period `2026-01` to `2026-11` (requested for `2026-01-01` to `2026-11-22`, with sub-periods `2026-10` and `2026-11`; no label filters applied). Note that November 2026 is a partial month up to today (`2026-11-22`), and the report output does not explicitly label whether the accounting basis is accrual or cash (though the presence of Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable on the Balance Sheet indicates accrual tracking).
* **Balance Sheet report** (`balance-sheet`), as of `2026-11-22` (no label filters applied).
* **Drafts:** Checked active proposals (`list_proposals`); there are no pending draft changes included in these figures. Prior-year (2025) figures were not checked.
